name: Honda CB400F Super Sport
engine: 408 cc air-cooled SOHC inline four, four 20 mm carbs, six-speed
intro: The 400 Four, with its four-into-one exhaust. A small, complex four that rewards careful work.

A-003.title: Get the service manual
A-003.instructions: Get the Honda factory service manual, or the Haynes manual that covers the CB400F and CB550 fours.
A-003.reason: Every torque value, clearance and capacity in this course comes from the manual.

add.title: Test the oil pressure switch
add.instructions: With the ignition on and the engine off, the oil light should come on. Start it and it should go out. Check for oil seeping from the switch.
add.reason: The oil pressure switch is a common fault on these bikes.

add.title: Check the clutch shaft splines
add.instructions: With the clutch cover off, check the clutch shaft splines for wear and notching.
add.reason: Worn splines eventually stop the clutch from releasing properly.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Oil pressure switch
known.what: A common fault on the 400 Four.

known.title: Clutch shaft splines
known.what: Wear over time until the clutch drags.
